verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, all covered by its SLA. It also ships official InstantSearch UI libraries, plus an agent skill for migrating client code across major versions. Community users independently praise InstantSearch across JS, React, Vue, Angular, iOS and Android, and note the API has been stable. Missing for 10: in-depth per-SDK reference evidence (installation, typing, versioning details) and independent hands-on corroboration of the backend API clients specifically.
